"""Read-only local sizing and provenance audit; emits no source writing."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import Counter
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import polars as pl
import yaml
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

ROOT = Path('/Users/desmondchoy/Projects/twinkl')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from src.north_star import assessment
from src.north_star.provider import openai_input_payload, stable_hash
from src.north_star.review import SourceEntry
from src.wrangling.parse_synthetic_data import parse_persona_file
from src.wrangling.parse_wrangled_data import parse_wrangled_file

OUT = Path('/tmp/nsm_history_readiness_audit.json')
COHORTS = [
    'docs/north_star/cohorts/known_drift_personas.md',
    'docs/north_star/cohorts/non_drift_personas.md',
]
MODEL = 'nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5'
REVISION = 'e9b6763023c676ca8431644204f50c2b100d9aab'
TOKENIZER_DIR = Path.home()/'.cache/huggingface/hub/models--nomic-ai--nomic-embed-text-v1.5/snapshots'/REVISION
TOKENIZER = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(TOKENIZER_DIR, local_files_only=True)
POLICY = json.loads((ROOT/'config/evals/north_star_integration_v1.json').read_text())
VALUES = {
    k.lower().replace('-', '_'): {
        'core_value': k.lower().replace('-', '_'),
        'user_phrase': v['user_phrase'].strip(),
        'approved_definition': v['definition'].strip(),
    }
    for k,v in yaml.safe_load((ROOT/'config/schwartz_values.yaml').read_text())['values'].items()
}
REGISTRY = {r['persona_id']:r for r in pl.read_parquet(ROOT/'logs/registry/personas.parquet').to_dicts()}

def norm(value):
    return value.lower().replace('-', '_')

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def stats(values):
    arr=np.asarray(values)
    return {'n':len(values), 'sum':int(arr.sum()), 'min':int(arr.min()),
            'p50':float(np.percentile(arr,50)), 'p90':float(np.percentile(arr,90)),
            'p95':float(np.percentile(arr,95)), 'max':int(arr.max())} if len(values) else {'n':0}

def measure_request(sources, value, mode='source', quote_source=None):
    system,prompt=assessment.build_source_prompt(**value,sources=sources)
    payload=json.loads(prompt)
    schema=assessment.source_json_schema()
    if mode=='source':
        payload['context_hash']='0'*64  # fixed-width runtime hash, sizing only
    else:
        # Worst-case proposed quote copies one full component. No semantic
        # selection/validation is attempted by this audit.
        source=sources[0]
        system=assessment.CANDIDATE_SYSTEM_PROMPT
        schema=assessment.candidate_json_schema()
        payload['proposed_quote']={
            'entry_id':source.entry_id,'quote_source':quote_source,
            'evidence_quote':getattr(source,quote_source),
        }
    request={'system':system,'prompt':json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True),
             'schema':schema,'provider':'openai','role':'runtime' if mode=='source' else 'reference',
             'purpose':'nsm-audit-sizing'}
    serialized=json.dumps(request,ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    count_payload=openai_input_payload(request,POLICY)
    return {
        'request_utf8_bytes':len(serialized),
        'provider_conservative_input_bound':len(serialized)+2048,
        'openai_payload_utf8_bytes':len(json.dumps(count_payload,ensure_ascii=False).encode()),
    }

audit={'scope':'Mechanical counts and input sizing only. No source writing in output; no provider calls.',
       'git_head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
       'cohort_ids':{},'provenance':{},'issues':[],'personas':[],'requests':{},
       'tokenizer':{'model':MODEL,'revision':REVISION,'model_max_length':TOKENIZER.model_max_length,
                    'local_files_only':True,'truncation':False,
                    'document_template':'search_document: Journal Entry:\n{initial_entry}\n\nPersona nudge response:\n{response_text} (response block omitted when absent)'}}
for path in COHORTS:
    audit['cohort_ids'][path]=re.findall(r'^\| `([a-f0-9]{8})` \|',(ROOT/path).read_text(),re.M)
ids=[p for group in audit['cohort_ids'].values() for p in group]
if len(ids)!=len(set(ids)) or len(ids)!=105: raise ValueError('Cohort IDs not 105 unique')
audit['selected_ids_sha256']=sha_ids=hashlib.sha256(('\n'.join(sorted(ids))+'\n').encode()).hexdigest()
source_paths=set(COHORTS+['logs/registry/personas.parquet','config/schwartz_values.yaml',
    'config/evals/north_star_integration_v1.json','src/wrangling/parse_synthetic_data.py',
    'src/wrangling/parse_wrangled_data.py','src/north_star/assessment.py','src/north_star/review.py',
    'src/north_star/runtime.py','src/north_star/input_budget.py','src/north_star/provider.py',
    'scripts/experiments/north_star_phase0.py','scripts/experiments/north_star_luna.py'])
measurements={name:[] for name in ['journal_chars','response_chars','candidate_chars','candidate_utf8_bytes',
    'nomic_candidate_tokens','history_chars','entries_per_persona','responses_per_persona']}
request_groups={name:[] for name in ['full_history_source_value','single_source_value','largest_three_source_value',
                                   'full_component_quote_upper_bound']}
issues=audit['issues']
counts=Counter()
candidate_rows=[]
for pid in sorted(ids):
    row=REGISTRY[pid]
    raw_rel=f'logs/synthetic_data/persona_{pid}.md'
    wrangled_rel=f'logs/wrangled/persona_{pid}.md'
    source_paths.update([raw_rel,wrangled_rel])
    raw_path, wrangled_path=ROOT/raw_rel,ROOT/wrangled_rel
    for p in [raw_path,wrangled_path]:
        if not p.exists(): issues.append({'persona_id':pid,'kind':'missing_file','file':str(p)})
    raw_text=raw_path.read_text()
    original_profile,original=parse_persona_file(raw_path)
    profile,entries,warnings=parse_wrangled_file(wrangled_path)
    counts['original_entries']+=len(original)
    counts['wrangled_entries']+=len(entries)
    for warning in warnings:
        issues.append({'persona_id':pid,'kind':'parse_warning','entry':warning.entry_index,'message':warning.message})
    if len(original)!=len(entries): issues.append({'persona_id':pid,'kind':'entry_count_mismatch','raw':len(original),'wrangled':len(entries)})
    if [e['t_index'] for e in entries]!=list(range(len(entries))): issues.append({'persona_id':pid,'kind':'noncontiguous_t_index'})
    headers=re.findall(r'^## Entry (\d+) - (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})',raw_text,re.M)
    if len(headers)!=len(original): issues.append({'persona_id':pid,'kind':'original_header_count_mismatch'})
    if [norm(v) for v in profile['core_values']]!=[norm(v) for v in row['core_values']]:
        issues.append({'persona_id':pid,'kind':'registry_value_mismatch'})
    if [norm(v) for v in original_profile['core_values']]!=[norm(v) for v in profile['core_values']]:
        issues.append({'persona_id':pid,'kind':'original_value_mismatch'})
    ds=[date.fromisoformat(e['date']) for e in entries]
    if ds!=sorted(ds): issues.append({'persona_id':pid,'kind':'decreasing_dates'})
    if len(ds)!=len(set(ds)): counts['personas_with_same_day_entries']+=1
    sources=[]
    history_chars=0
    responses=0
    nudges=0
    for initial,e in zip(original,entries):
        eid=f'{pid}:entry:{e["t_index"]}'
        if initial['date']!=e['date']: issues.append({'entry_id':eid,'kind':'date_mismatch'})
        for field in ['initial_entry','nudge_text','response_text']:
            a,b=initial.get(field),e.get(field)
            if a!=b: issues.append({'entry_id':eid,'kind':'raw_wrangled_mismatch','field':field,
                                   'raw_chars':len(a or ''),'wrangled_chars':len(b or '')})
            if b:
                counts[f'{field}_nonempty']+=1
                if b not in raw_text: issues.append({'entry_id':eid,'kind':'not_verbatim_in_original','field':field})
        if e.get('response_text') and not e.get('nudge_text'):
            issues.append({'entry_id':eid,'kind':'response_without_nudge'})
        counts['original_responses']+=bool(initial.get('response_text'))
        counts['original_nudges']+=bool(initial.get('nudge_text'))
        text=e['initial_entry'] or ''
        response=e.get('response_text') or ''
        responses+=bool(response); nudges+=bool(e.get('nudge_text'))
        if not text: issues.append({'entry_id':eid,'kind':'empty_journal'})
        candidate='search_document: Journal Entry:\n'+text
        if response: candidate+='\n\nPersona nudge response:\n'+response
        toks=len(TOKENIZER(candidate,truncation=False)['input_ids'])
        candidate_rows.append({'entry_id':eid,'tokens':toks,'chars':len(candidate)})
        for k,value in [('journal_chars',len(text)),('response_chars',len(response)),
                        ('candidate_chars',len(candidate)),('candidate_utf8_bytes',len(candidate.encode())),
                        ('nomic_candidate_tokens',toks)]: measurements[k].append(value)
        history_chars+=len(text)+len(response)
        sources.append(SourceEntry(entry_id=eid,journal_entry=text,nudge_response=response or None))
    measurements['history_chars'].append(history_chars)
    measurements['entries_per_persona'].append(len(entries))
    measurements['responses_per_persona'].append(responses)
    audit['personas'].append({'persona_id':pid,'entries':len(entries),'nudges':nudges,'responses':responses,
                            'user_writing_chars':history_chars,'first_date':str(min(ds)),'last_date':str(max(ds)),
                            'date_span_days':(max(ds)-min(ds)).days})
    largest_three=sorted(sources,key=lambda s:len(json.dumps(s.model_dump(),ensure_ascii=False).encode()),reverse=True)[:3]
    for core in row['core_values']:
        value=VALUES[norm(core)]
        for name,batch in [('full_history_source_value',sources),('largest_three_source_value',largest_three)]:
            request_groups[name].append({'persona_id':pid,'core_value':norm(core),'source_count':len(batch),
                                        **measure_request(batch,value)})
        for source in sources:
            request_groups['single_source_value'].append({'entry_id':source.entry_id,'core_value':norm(core),
                                                          **measure_request([source],value)})
            fields=['journal_entry']+(['nudge_response'] if source.nudge_response else [])
            quoted=max(fields,key=lambda k:len(getattr(source,k).encode()))
            request_groups['full_component_quote_upper_bound'].append({'entry_id':source.entry_id,
                'core_value':norm(core),'quote_source':quoted,
                **measure_request([source],value,'quote',quoted)})

audit['counts']=dict(counts)
audit['measurements']={k:stats(v) for k,v in measurements.items()}
audit['longest_candidates']=sorted(candidate_rows,key=lambda r:r['tokens'],reverse=True)[:10]
for name,rows in request_groups.items():
    audit['requests'][name]={
        'n':len(rows),
        **{metric:stats([r[metric] for r in rows]) for metric in [
            'request_utf8_bytes','provider_conservative_input_bound','openai_payload_utf8_bytes']},
        'conservative_bound_over_16000':sum(r['provider_conservative_input_bound']>16000 for r in rows),
        'conservative_bound_over_64000':sum(r['provider_conservative_input_bound']>64000 for r in rows),
        'largest':max(rows,key=lambda r:r['provider_conservative_input_bound']),
    }
for path in sorted(source_paths): audit['provenance'][path]=sha(ROOT/path)
audit['provenance_manifest_sha256']=stable_hash(audit['provenance'])
audit['tokenizer']['file_hashes']={p.name:sha(p) for p in TOKENIZER_DIR.iterdir()
    if p.name in ['tokenizer.json','tokenizer_config.json','special_tokens_map.json','vocab.txt','config.json']}
audit['versions']={package:importlib.metadata.version(package) for package in ['numpy','polars','transformers','tokenizers']}
audit['audit_script_sha256']=sha(Path(__file__))
audit['limits']={
 'Luna':'No local Luna tokenizer or provider counts. UTF-8 byte bound + 2048 mirrors provider.py budget logic, is conservative and is not a measured token count.',
 'request_sizing':'Full histories and largest-three sets are size probes, not actual weekly cases or retrieval results. Per-source-value means one complete entry plus response and its approved value definition.',
 'quotation_sizing':'Worst-case quotation repeats the entire longer component for envelope sizing; no quotation was selected or judged.',
 'Nomic':'Exact cached tokenizer counts, complete candidate with entry and response; this illustrative response template still requires freezing in the runner.',
 'source_review_architecture':'Runtime batches full eligible history separately per Core Value. Source schema can batch entries; old reference runner batches four source/value pairs. Quote assessment receives one complete source.',
}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(audit,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in audit.items() if k not in ['provenance','personas','cohort_ids']},indent=2,sort_keys=True))
print('OUTPUT',OUT,'SHA256',sha(OUT))

"""Count input tokens without generation; persist metadata and hashes only."""
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
import re
import sys
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import polars as pl
import yaml
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from openai import APIConnectionError, APIStatusError, AsyncOpenAI

ROOT=Path('/Users/desmondchoy/Projects/twinkl')
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from src.north_star import assessment, input_budget
from src.north_star.provider import stable_hash
from src.north_star.review import SourceEntry
from src.wrangling.parse_wrangled_data import parse_wrangled_file

OUT=Path('/tmp/nsm_luna_token_audit.json')
COHORTS=['docs/north_star/cohorts/known_drift_personas.md','docs/north_star/cohorts/non_drift_personas.md']
POLICY_PATH='config/evals/north_star_integration_v1.json'
POLICY=json.loads((ROOT/POLICY_PATH).read_text())
VALUE_PATH='config/schwartz_values.yaml'
VALUES={name.lower().replace('-','_'):{'core_value':name.lower().replace('-','_'),
    'user_phrase':value['user_phrase'].strip(),'approved_definition':value['definition'].strip()}
    for name,value in yaml.safe_load((ROOT/VALUE_PATH).read_text())['values'].items()}
REGISTRY={row['persona_id']:row for row in pl.read_parquet(ROOT/'logs/registry/personas.parquet').to_dicts()}

def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def make_request(sources,value,kind='source',quote_source=None):
    system,prompt=assessment.build_source_prompt(**value,sources=sources)
    body=json.loads(prompt)
    schema=assessment.source_json_schema()
    if kind=='source': body['context_hash']='0'*64
    else:
        source=sources[0]
        system=assessment.CANDIDATE_SYSTEM_PROMPT
        schema=assessment.candidate_json_schema()
        body['proposed_quote']={'entry_id':source.entry_id,'quote_source':quote_source,
                               'evidence_quote':getattr(source,quote_source)}
    return {'system':system,'prompt':json.dumps(body,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True),'schema':schema,
            'provider':'openai','role':'runtime' if kind=='source' else 'reference','purpose':'nsm-audit-sizing'}

def build_probes():
    ids=[pid for path in COHORTS for pid in re.findall(r'^\| `([a-f0-9]{8})` \|',(ROOT/path).read_text(),re.M)]
    assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))==105
    provenance_paths=set(COHORTS+[POLICY_PATH,VALUE_PATH,'logs/registry/personas.parquet',
        'src/north_star/assessment.py','src/north_star/review.py','src/north_star/provider.py',
        'src/north_star/input_budget.py','src/wrangling/parse_wrangled_data.py'])
    full=[];shortlist=[];quotation=[]
    for pid in sorted(ids):
        path=f'logs/wrangled/persona_{pid}.md'
        provenance_paths.update([path,f'logs/synthetic_data/persona_{pid}.md'])
        profile,rows,warnings=parse_wrangled_file(ROOT/path)
        if warnings: raise ValueError('Parse warnings found')
        sources=[SourceEntry(entry_id=f'{pid}:entry:{row["t_index"]}',journal_entry=row['initial_entry'],
                            nudge_response=row.get('response_text') or None) for row in reversed(rows)]
        largest_three=sorted(sources,key=lambda source:len(json.dumps(source.model_dump(),ensure_ascii=False).encode()),reverse=True)[:3]
        for core in REGISTRY[pid]['core_values']:
            value=VALUES[core.lower().replace('-','_')]
            common={'persona_id':pid,'core_value':value['core_value']}
            full.append({**common,'probe_kind':'full_history_source_value','source_count':len(sources),
                         'request':make_request(sources,value)})
            shortlist.append({**common,'probe_kind':'largest_three_source_value','source_count':len(largest_three),
                              'request':make_request(largest_three,value)})
            for source in sources:
                component=max(['journal_entry']+(['nudge_response'] if source.nudge_response else []),
                              key=lambda key:len(getattr(source,key).encode()))
                quotation.append({**common,'probe_kind':'full_component_quote_upper_bound','source_count':1,
                                  'entry_id':source.entry_id,'quote_source':component,
                                  'request':make_request([source],value,'quote',component)})
    size=lambda p:len(json.dumps(p['request'],ensure_ascii=False).encode())
    probes=full+[max(shortlist,key=size),max(quotation,key=size)]
    return ids,probes,{path:sha(ROOT/path) for path in sorted(provenance_paths)}

def describe_probe(probe):
    request=probe['request']; payload=input_budget.count_payload(request,POLICY)
    return {k:v for k,v in probe.items() if k!='request'}|{
        'request_hash':stable_hash(request),'payload_hash':stable_hash(payload),
        'model':payload['model'],'reasoning_effort':payload['reasoning']['effort'],
        'system_prompt_sha256':hashlib.sha256(request['system'].encode()).hexdigest(),
        'user_prompt_sha256':hashlib.sha256(request['prompt'].encode()).hexdigest(),
        'schema_hash':stable_hash(request['schema']),
        'request_utf8_bytes':len(json.dumps(request,ensure_ascii=False).encode()),
        'provider_conservative_input_bound':len(json.dumps(request,ensure_ascii=False).encode())+2048,
    }

async def main():
    ids,probes,provenance=build_probes()
    state={'audit_kind':'input_token_size_probes_without_generation','created_at':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        'scope':'150 full-history Persona/Core Value probes plus two maximum-size diagnostic probes; not weekly cases or NSM judgments.',
        'selected_ids_sha256':hashlib.sha256(('\n'.join(sorted(ids))+'\n').encode()).hexdigest(),
        'provenance':provenance,'provenance_manifest_hash':stable_hash(provenance),
        'audit_script_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'openai_sdk_version':importlib.metadata.version('openai'),
        'settings':{'concurrency':4,'sdk_retries':0,'timeout_seconds':180,'max_transport_attempts':2,
                    'endpoint':'responses.input_tokens.count','generation_calls':0,'source_order':'newest first',
                    'context_hash':'fixed-width all-zero 64-character placeholder for sizing only',
                    'truncation':'disabled'},
        'limitations':['Probes include complete synthetic histories and immediate responses, not frozen weekly eligibility.',
                       'Quote bound duplicates an entire source component for sizing; it is not a valid selected-card claim.',
                       'Final prompts, inputs, source windows and context hashes require new matching token receipts.'],
        'receipts':[],'failures':[]}
    def save():
        temporary=OUT.with_suffix('.tmp')
        temporary.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
        os.replace(temporary,OUT)
    save()
    load_dotenv(ROOT/'.env',override=False)
    if not os.environ.get('OPENAI_API_KEY'): raise RuntimeError('OPENAI_API_KEY unavailable')
    sem=asyncio.Semaphore(4)
    async with AsyncOpenAI(max_retries=0,timeout=180) as client:
        async def count_one(probe):
            async with sem:
                metadata=describe_probe(probe)
                attempts=[]
                for number in [1,2]:
                    try:
                        result=await client.responses.input_tokens.count(**input_budget.count_payload(probe['request'],POLICY))
                        receipt={**metadata,'input_tokens':getattr(result,'input_tokens',None),
                                 'provider_request_id':getattr(result,'_request_id',None),
                                 'counted_at':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),'attempt_count':number,
                                 'previous_attempts':attempts}
                        input_budget.validate_receipt(probe['request'],POLICY,receipt)
                        state['receipts'].append(receipt)
                        save()
                        done=len(state['receipts'])+len(state['failures'])
                        if done%10==0 or done==len(probes):
                            print(json.dumps({'completed':done,'total':len(probes),'successful':len(state['receipts']),
                                              'failed':len(state['failures'])}),flush=True)
                        return
                    except Exception as exc:
                        # Never log request payloads, source writing, API keys, or
                        # arbitrary provider response text.
                        status=getattr(exc,'status_code',None)
                        error={'attempt':number,'exception_type':type(exc).__name__,'http_status':status,
                               'request_id':getattr(exc,'request_id',None)}
                        attempts.append(error)
                        retry=isinstance(exc,APIConnectionError) or (isinstance(exc,APIStatusError) and
                              (status==429 or (isinstance(status,int) and status>=500)))
                        if number==1 and retry:
                            await asyncio.sleep(1)
                            continue
                        state['failures'].append({**metadata,'attempts':attempts})
                        save()
                        print(json.dumps({'failed_probe':metadata['probe_kind'],'persona_id':metadata['persona_id'],
                                          'error':error}),flush=True)
                        return
        await count_one(probes[0])
        if state['receipts']:
            await asyncio.gather(*(count_one(probe) for probe in probes[1:]))
        else:
            state['preflight_failed']=True
            print('Count preflight failed; remaining probes not sent.',flush=True)
    values=[r['input_tokens'] for r in state['receipts'] if r['probe_kind']=='full_history_source_value']
    state['summary']={'planned':len(probes),'successful':len(state['receipts']),'failed':len(state['failures']),
                      'total_api_attempts':sum(r['attempt_count'] for r in state['receipts'])+
                                           sum(len(r['attempts']) for r in state['failures']),
                      'full_history_counts':{'n':len(values),'min':min(values) if values else None,
                          'median':float(np.median(values)) if values else None,
                          'p95':float(np.percentile(values,95)) if values else None,
                          'max':max(values) if values else None,
                          'over_16000':sum(value>16000 for value in values)},
                      'comparison_probes':[r for r in state['receipts'] if r['probe_kind']!='full_history_source_value']}
    state['completed_at']=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    save()
    print(json.dumps(state['summary'],indent=2),flush=True)
    print('OUTPUT',str(OUT),'SHA256',sha(OUT),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__': asyncio.run(main())

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,re
from collections import Counter
from urllib.parse import unquote
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
from scipy.optimize import Bounds,LinearConstraint,milp
ROOT=Path('/Users/desmondchoy/Projects/twinkl')
P=ROOT/'logs/experiments/reports/north_star_20260906/nsm_experiment.json'
x=json.loads(P.read_text())
p=x['partition']; dev=set(p['development_persona_ids']); final=set(p['final_persona_ids'])
assert len(dev)==81 and len(final)==24 and not dev&final
ids=dev|final
assert hashlib.sha256(('\n'.join(sorted(ids))+'\n').encode()).hexdigest()==p['combined_105_ids_sha256']
serialized=json.dumps({k:p[k] for k in ['development_persona_ids','final_persona_ids']},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n'
assert hashlib.sha256(serialized.encode()).hexdigest()==p['partition_sha256']
registry={r['persona_id']:r for r in pl.read_parquet(ROOT/'logs/registry/personas.parquet').to_dicts()}
added=sorted(p['added_final_persona_ids']+p['added_development_persona_ids'])
values=sorted({v for pid in added for v in registry[pid]['core_values']})
A=np.array([[1]*70]+[[int(v in registry[pid]['core_values']) for pid in added] for v in values],dtype=float)
c=np.array([int(hashlib.sha256(f'20260906:final:{pid}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:12],16)/16**12 for pid in added])
r=milp(c,integrality=np.ones(70),bounds=Bounds(0,1),constraints=LinearConstraint(A,[16]+[2]*10,[16]+[3]*10),options={'mip_rel_gap':0.0})
assert r.success
assert [pid for pid,v in zip(added,np.rint(r.x).astype(int)) if v]==p['added_final_persona_ids']
for group,key in [('added_final_persona_ids','added_final'),('added_development_persona_ids','added_development'),('development_persona_ids','all_development'),('final_persona_ids','all_final')]:
 count=Counter(v for pid in p[group] for v in registry[pid]['core_values'])
 assert dict(count)==p['memberships'][key]
up=x['audits']['upstream_weekly_inputs']; weeks=up['weekly_states']
assert len(weeks)==501 and len({(r['persona_id'],r['week_start']) for r in weeks})==501
assert {r['persona_id'] for r in weeks}==ids
for split,group in [('development',dev),('final',final)]:
 rows=[r for r in weeks if r['persona_id'] in group]
 expected=up['partition']['repeat1_counts'][split]
 assert len(rows)==expected['observed_weeks']
 assert dict(Counter(r['state'] for r in rows))==expected['states']
assert dict(Counter(r['state'] for r in weeks))=={'active_drift':24,'no_active_drift':443,'insufficient_evidence':34}
assert len(up['span_empty_weeks'])==3 and up['span_weeks']==504
assert up['missing']=={'personas':[],'prompts':[],'responses_by_run':{'1':[],'2':[],'3':[]}}
assert not up['prompt_boundary_anomalies'] and not up['raw_source_mismatches']
assert up['saved_drift_outputs_checked']==29 and not up['saved_drift_output_mismatches']
history=x['audits']['history_readiness']; assert not history['issues']
assert history['counts']['wrangled_entries']==881 and history['counts']['response_text_nonempty']==400
counts=x['audits']['luna_token_counts']; assert counts['summary']['successful']==152 and not counts['failures']
assert len(counts['receipts'])==152
assert counts['summary']['full_history_counts']['max']==4095 and counts['summary']['full_history_counts']['over_16000']==0
for r in counts['receipts']:
 assert r['provider_request_id'] and 0<=r['input_tokens']<=16000
assert x['execution']=={'runtime_generation_calls':0,'reference_generation_calls':0,'human_reviews':0,'variants':{},'metrics':None}
assert x['frozen_settings']['spending']['total_cap_usd'] is None
assert x['frozen_settings']['spending']['per_attempt_cap_usd'] is None
checked={}
for audit in ['history_readiness','upstream_weekly_inputs','luna_token_counts']:
 obj=x['audits'][audit]
 for field in ['provenance','source_hashes','source_file_hashes']:
  for path,expected in obj.get(field,{}).items():
   if isinstance(expected,str) and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}',expected) and not path.startswith('docs/'):
    actual=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert actual==expected,(path,actual,expected)
    checked[path]=actual
for script in x['reproduction']['scripts'].values():
 assert hashlib.sha256(script['source'].encode()).hexdigest()==script['sha256']
files=[ROOT/'docs/north_star/nsm_experiment_methodology.md',ROOT/'docs/north_star/cohorts/known_drift_personas.md',ROOT/'docs/north_star/cohorts/non_drift_personas.md']
links=0
for file in files:
 text=file.read_text()
 for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^\s)]+)\)',text):
  if target.startswith(('https://','http://','mailto:')): continue
  raw,_,anchor=unquote(target).partition('#')
  dest=(file.parent/raw).resolve() if raw else file
  assert dest.exists(),(file,target)
  if anchor and dest.suffix=='.md':
   headings=re.findall(r'^#+\s+(.+)$',dest.read_text(),re.M)
   slugs=[re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]','',h.lower()).replace(' ','-') for h in headings]
   assert anchor in slugs,(file,target)
  links+=1
# Cohort rows remain exactly as before this audit; only their introductions changed.
import subprocess
for file in files[1:]:
 before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:'+str(file.relative_to(ROOT))],cwd=ROOT,text=True)
 rows=lambda text:re.findall(r'^\| `[a-f0-9]{8}` \|.*$',text,re.M)
 assert rows(before)==rows(file.read_text())
print(json.dumps({'partition_reproduced':True,'personas':105,'weeks':501,'input_token_receipts':152,'unchanged_source_and_code_hashes':len(checked),'local_links_and_anchors':links,'cohort_rows_preserved':105,'application_tests':'not run; source code unchanged'},indent=2))
